failure_modes.name: unhandled_escalation_trigger
failure_modes.binary_definition: The agent encounters a situation that requires escalation to human support (disputes, permission restrictions, ambiguous cases, above-threshold refunds, or unclear policy interpretation) but fails to call the escalate_to_human tool.
close_negatives: Agent correctly denies access with explanation

failure_modes.name: internal_language_exposed
failure_modes.binary_definition: The agent uses internal system language, jargon, or technical implementation details in customer-facing responses instead of plain conversational English.

failure_modes.name: excessive_verbosity
failure_modes.binary_definition: The agent provides unnecessary information, repeats details, or goes into detail about scenarios the customer didn't ask about.

failure_modes.name: tone_misalignment
failure_modes.binary_definition: The agent uses emotionally inappropriate tone (e.g., 'great!' when customer wants to return an item, enthusiasm about refunds or complaints).

failure_modes.name: factual_error
failure_modes.binary_definition: The agent provides incorrect information about order status, policy, eligibility, permissions, or business rules.

failure_modes.name: unnecessary_question
failure_modes.binary_definition: The agent asks for information the customer already provided or that the agent should already have access to.
